## Summary

**Diagnosis:** In `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs::wrap_bare_frontmatter` (which converts bare front matter into fenced `---` form so the downstream MetadataBlock parser can read it), the header was being filtered with `!l.starts_with(' ')`. That dropped any indented line — which is exactly what YAML uses for sequence items and nested mappings. So a bare front matter like:

```
title: Foo
depends:
  - foo
```

was rewritten to:

```
---
title: Foo
depends:
---
```

leaving `depends` as null. `DocumentFinder::metadata_matches` then never matched `depends=foo`. Documents using fenced (`---`) front matter bypassed `wrap_bare_frontmatter` entirely, so they worked.

**Fix:** Removed the indented-line filter and emit the header verbatim, so YAML sequences and nested structure are preserved. Added regression test `crates/liwe/tests/bare_frontmatter_meta_test.rs`. Full `cargo test` is green.
